sentence: According to the Committee, for the future, the importations of civilian use explosives accessories can be allowed by the Government in collaboration with MINUSCA, UNMAS and the Panel of Experts.130 The Committee also stressed the importance of receiving assurances that appropriate safeguards are put in place to minimize the risk of diversion of the explosives and accessories and that they are safely stored and accounted for.131 129 Document of 11 July 2019, Chair of the Security Council Committee established pursuant to resolution 2127 (2013) concerning the Central African Republic.
